entities.entity: Funds Transfer and Payment Authorization Controls Question
entities.criteria: Questions covering organizational controls governing the initiation, modification, approval, and execution of financial transactions and funds transfers. Includes procedures to prevent unauthorized or fraudulent payments, such as controls requiring independent verification of changes to payment instructions or beneficiary bank account details using a secondary communication method (e.g., phone verification, callback confirmation, or other out-of-band validation) and dual authorization or approval by two authorized personnel before executing money transfers. Also includes payment approval workflows, separation-of-duties practices, and operational procedures ensuring that updates to payment details and outgoing transfers are validated and approved prior to release of funds.
